title.narrative: EU COVID-2019 Solidarity Programme for the Eastern Partnership - Health

description.narrative: The European Union has deployed a comprehensive, coordinated, and forward-looking response to the COVID-19 pandemic in the Eastern partner countries. EU support of 30 million is provided in cooperation with the World Health Organization and will help partner countries to strengthen their health sector and get ready for dealing with the pandemic. EU support will reach medical workers and other workers on the first line of response, patients, and vulnerable people all those most in need.
